about: WEEKLY RELEASE TRAIN (HQ + Brandon Oct 28 '1-5'): everything that passed its checker that week ships to MEMBERS in ONE batch on release day (Sunday evening) after Brandon's ONE GO. Chat 3 adds the batch here when the GO comes; the Club Room's 'What's new' box shows the newest batch on top. kind = 2fer | links | hours | camp | outline | other (2fer/links/hours/camp/outline items carry the notices on the box). where = the page that now shows it.
